resources.string: Enter 1–2402 MHz (default 1000). Below this limit reception uses the BT oscillator; at or above it reception is direct. Stop and restart RX after saving.

LG D325 reception requires root and a compatible modified kernel and modem. Installing this APK does not prepare a stock phone. Choose a source and start reception.
IQ files support CI8 (signed 8-bit), CU8 (unsigned 8-bit) and CI16 (signed 16-bit, little-endian). Enter the recorded sample rate and centre frequency. CI8 legacy uses the same signed format.
Scroll the table horizontally. Ranges refer to the modem input frequency; sensitivity depends on the B1/B8 SAW filter and RF path.
Auto chooses the PLL profile by frequency. Profile 500 is not used because stable PLL lock has not been confirmed.
Below the BT receive limit: modem frequency = (2402 + BT channel) MHz minus receive frequency. At or above the limit, reception is direct.

5 MHz: native 7.68 MS/s; 2 MHz: FIR /3, 2.56 MS/s; 1 MHz: FIR /6, 1.28 MS/s. Manual raw IQ recording uses 7.68 MS/s; automated recording uses the selected rate. Freeze pauses the spectrum and waterfall while audio remains available.
Pauses background apps, launcher, Google services and the notification shade. Display, audio and reception services continue. Freezing does not free RAM and may cause black screens.
Frees RAM used by background apps. The notification shade works; Android may restart services.
No memory cleanup, freezing or CPU mode change.
The selected mode applies at the next reception start. Disabling takes effect immediately. Stopping, leaving the app or losing its connection releases frozen processes and restores CPU mode.
SDR receiver with live spectrum and waterfall, AM/NFM/WFM/USB/LSB/CW, IQ recording and demodulated audio.
